basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, is hiring one Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) for the ICMR-sponsored PRAGATICAR project, on consolidated compensation of up to Rs. 67,000 per month depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The essential qualification is MBBS/BVSc/BDS or equivalent. Applications are invited online (advertisement no. IIT/SRIC/R/CIH/2026/104) and the last date is 9 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply online for advertisement no. IIT/SRIC/R/CIH/2026/104; the notice does not print the portal address.
Submit the application on or before 9 December 2026.

The application fee is Rs. 0 for all categories. The notice nonetheless prints a bank account for fee deposit: State Bank of India (00202), account name IIT SRIC-OM Account, account no. 39502115210, IFSC SBIN0000202, SWIFT code SBININBB339, payable by RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the selection process in detail.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur (Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy)

PRAGATICAR: Centre for Advanced Research on Frugal Diagnostics, Regenerative and Personalised Healthcare, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Health, Advanced Therapeutics, Translational Innovation, and Inclusive Healthcare (Project Code – R/CIH)
12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Consolidated compensation up to Rs. 67,000 per month (depending on qualification and experience)
Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST

rows.desirable: Experience in public health/clinical research, medical-device evaluation, clinical studies, patient-facing research, technology validation

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 67,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The assignment lasts 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier, and it is described as temporary.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview and states that meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. The interview date, mode and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the IIT Kharagpur Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS/BVSc/BDS or equivalent. Experience in public health/clinical research, medical-device evaluation, clinical studies, patient-facing research or technology validation is desired.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 67,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are made online. Transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the assignment, and is it permanent?
faq.answer: It is a temporary assignment lasting 12 months or until the project terminates, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which agency sponsors the project?
faq.answer: The project is sponsored by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), New Delhi.
